verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows a pinned CLI version (ultrametric@0.4.1) and integer version selection for process guides. Nothing documents release notes, a changelog, or a diff of what changed in the skill files before an update. Version selection and record history are adjacent features, not change notes.

support.subject: As a developer, releases ship with notes or a changelog so I can see what changed in the skills before I take an update
